description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_CompileAllConfig, which is a method class for compiling all configuration files within the Smarty templating engine. It extends a base class Smarty_Internal_Method_CompileAllTemplates and provides a method compileAllConfig() to trigger recompilation of configuration files with optional parameters.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_CompileAllConfig
classes.description: A class that provides a method to compile all Smarty configuration files, extending the base compilation method for templates.

methods.name: compileAllConfig
methods.description: Compiles all configuration files with optional parameters for file extension, force recompilation, time limit, and maximum errors.
